title: Embedding Index Rebuild Strategies
excerpt: Changing embedding models without a rebuild plan silently poisons retrieval. Large reindex jobs need blue/green discipline, metadata locks, and offline quality gates—not a weekend heroics script.
description: Staff patterns for embedding index rebuilds: shadow indexes, alias cutovers, model version metadata, cost estimation, and golden-set regression gates.

sections.heading: Model swaps are silent regressions
paragraphs: Production search can stay live while a new index builds in the background. That is the default posture for staff teams, not a nice-to-have.
Feed a shadow index through dual-write or batch backfill, then cut over with an alias swap when offline metrics pass.

sections.heading: Blue/green avoids search downtime
paragraphs: Store embedding model id, chunk policy version, and normalization parameters in document metadata.
Query guards should reject incompatible versions; mixed vector spaces make retrieval look random in production.
points: Rebuild with blue/green or shadow indexes to avoid search downtime
Pin embedding model version in index metadata and query guards
Measure rebuild cost by shard size and batch job SLA
Gate quality regressions with offline golden retrieval sets

sections.heading: Pin model version in metadata
paragraphs: Estimate rebuild cost in shard count, batch size, and GPU or CPU hours before leadership approves a launch tied to the new index.
Bind overnight batch SLAs to the release calendar. A half-finished rebuild is worse than a delayed feature.

sections.heading: Gate cutover with golden sets
paragraphs: Run nDCG or hit@k against a golden retrieval set in CI before alias swap.
Optional short shadow-query comparison in live traffic gives final confidence without exposing users to bad answers.

sections.heading: Rebuild without taking search offline
paragraphs: Teams swap embedding models without rebuilding indexes and wonder why recall collapses for non-English catalogs. Treat index metadata as a contract: model id, chunk version, normalization, and source snapshot identifiers must match query guards. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Shadow indexes let you backfill while production serves traffic. Measure batch job duration per million vectors and cost per shard before committing to a weekend cutover. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Freeze chunking feature flags during backfill or you will fork corpora mid-job and invalidate comparisons. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Prove quality before alias swap
paragraphs: Offline golden question sets with expected document ids gate alias swaps. Block cutover when minority-language recall regresses even if headline English metrics look flat. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Keep the previous index read-only with a dated TTL so rollback is an alias change, not emergency re-embed. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Publish rebuild manifests—job ids, approvals, and consent classes—for auditors asking whether vectors include expired data. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Rebuild operations without search downtime
paragraphs: Changing embedding models or chunk policies silently poisons retrieval quality while dashboards still show green health checks. Build shadow indexes in parallel, backfill with batch jobs whose SLA you measure per shard, then swap aliases only after offline golden-set recall passes gates. Pin model identifier, chunk version, and normalization parameters in document metadata and reject queries that mismatch the active index contract. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Blue-green cutovers beat in-place reindex when traffic is continuous. Dual-write or staged ingestion into the shadow index prevents a big-bang weekend. Track rebuild cost in dollars and engineer hours per million vectors so finance can compare vendor upgrades to infra work. Freeze feature flags that alter chunk boundaries during backfill or you will fork incompatible corpora mid-job. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Quality gates belong in CI, not only in postmortems. Maintain labeled question sets with expected document identifiers; compare recall and nDCG before and after rebuild. Regression in minority languages or long-tail SKUs should block alias swap even when English headline metrics look flat. Document which teams consume which index alias in a catalog updated on every cutover. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Post-cutover, monitor query latency, cache hit rate, and support tickets tagged search for seventy-two hours. Keep the previous index read-only with a dated TTL so rollback is a DNS or alias change, not a panic re-embed. Archive rebuild manifests—source snapshot ids, batch job ids, and approval links—for auditors who ask whether vectors were trained on expired consent classes. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

sections.heading: Aramayı kapatmadan rebuild
paragraphs: Ekipler index rebuild etmeden embedding model değiştirip İngilizce dışı kataloglarda recall çöküşüne şaşırır. Index metadata'yı contract sayın: model id, chunk versiyonu, normalizasyon ve kaynak snapshot id query guard'larıyla eşleşmeli. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Shadow index backfill sırasında prod trafiğe hizmet verir. Hafta sonu cutover'a gitmeden milyon vektör başına batch süresi ve shard maliyetini ölçün. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Backfill sırasında chunk feature flag'lerini dondurun yoksa job ortasında corpus çatallanır ve kıyaslar geçersiz olur. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

sections.heading: Alias swap öncesi kaliteyi kanıtlayın
paragraphs: Beklenen doküman id'li offline golden soru setleri alias swap'i gate eder. İngilizce metrik düz görünse bile azınlık dili recall regresyonunda cutover'ı bloklayın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Önceki index'i tarihli TTL ile read-only tutun; rollback acil re-embed değil alias değişimi olsun. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Rebuild manifest'lerini—job id, onay, consent sınıfları—süresi dolmuş veri içerip içermediği sorulduğunda yayınlayın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

sections.heading: Arama kesintisi olmadan rebuild operasyonu
paragraphs: Embedding model veya chunk politikasını değiştirmek dashboard yeşilken retrieval kalitesini sessizce zehirler. Shadow index'i paralel kurun, shard başına SLA ölçtüğünüz batch job'larla backfill yapın, offline golden-set recall gate geçmeden alias swap etmeyin. Model id, chunk versiyonu ve normalizasyon parametrelerini metadata'da kilitleyin; aktif index contract'ına uymayan sorguları reddedin.

Sürekli trafikte blue-green cutover yerinde reindex'ten iyidir. Shadow index'e dual-write veya staged ingestion büyük patlama hafta sonunu önler. Rebuild maliyetini milyon vektör başına dolar ve mühendis saati olarak izleyin; finans vendor upgrade'i infra işiyle kıyaslasın. Backfill sırasında chunk sınırını değiştiren feature flag'leri dondurun yoksa job ortasında uyumsuz corpus çatallanır.

Kalite gate'leri yalnızca postmortem'de değil CI'da olmalı. Beklenen doküman id'leri olan etiketli soru setleri sürdürün; rebuild öncesi sonrası recall ve nDCG kıyaslayın. Azınlık dillerinde veya long-tail SKU'larda regresyon, İngilizce metrik düz görünse bile alias swap'i bloklasın. Her cutover'da güncellenen katalogda hangi ekibin hangi alias'ı tükettiğini yazın.

Cutover sonrası yetmiş iki saat query latency, cache hit rate ve arama etiketli destek ticket'larını izleyin. Önceki index'i tarihli TTL ile read-only tutun; rollback DNS veya alias değişimi olsun, panik re-embed değil. Rebuild manifest'lerini—kaynak snapshot id, batch job id, onay linkleri—arşivleyin; vektörlerin süresi dolmuş consent sınıfında eğitilip eğitilmediği sorulduğunda yanıtlayın.

points: 用蓝绿或影子索引规划无中断重建
在索引元数据锁定 embedding 模型版本
用分片大小与批任务 SLA 衡量重建成本
离线 golden set 门禁搜索质量回归

sections.heading: 元数据锁定模型版本
paragraphs: 用分片、批大小与 GPU/CPU 小时衡量重建成本；切换前预算审批。
夜间批 SLA 对齐发布日历；半截重建比延期更糟。

sections.heading: 离线 golden set 门禁
paragraphs: 切换前在 CI 用 golden set 验证 nDCG 或 hit@k。
上线前用短 shadow 查询对比做最终放行。

sections.heading: 不停机重建索引
paragraphs: 团队在不重建索引的情况下更换 embedding 模型，却困惑于非英语 catalog 的 recall 崩塌。将 index metadata 视为契约：model id、chunk 版本、归一化与源 snapshot id 须与 query guard 一致。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
shadow index 允许在 production 流量下回填。周末 cutover 前测量每百万向量的批作业时长与分片成本。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
回填期间冻结 chunk feature flag，否则会在作业中途分叉语料并使对比失效。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。

sections.heading: 切换 alias 前证明质量
paragraphs: 带期望文档 id 的离线 golden 问题集为 alias 切换把关。即使英文 headline 指标平坦，少数语言 recall 回归也应阻断 cutover。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
只读保留旧索引并设 dated TTL，使回滚只需改 alias 而非紧急重嵌。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
发布 rebuild 清单——job id、审批与 consent 类——以回应向量是否含过期数据的审计提问。 请在下次生产评审中复核这一点，指定负责人并关联带日期的整改工单。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。

sections.heading: 无搜索中断的重建运维
paragraphs: 更换 embedding 模型或 chunk 策略会在仪表盘仍绿时悄悄毒害检索质量。并行构建 shadow 索引，用按分片衡量 SLA 的批作业回填，离线 golden 集 recall 通过门禁后再切换 alias。在文档 metadata 中锁定模型 id、chunk 版本与归一化参数，拒绝与活跃索引契约不匹配的查询。
持续流量下 blue-green 切换优于原地 reindex。dual-write 或分阶段写入 shadow 索引可避免周末大爆炸。按百万向量跟踪重建的美元与工程师小时成本。回填期间冻结会改变 chunk 边界的 feature flag，否则会在作业中途分叉不兼容语料。
质量门禁应放在 CI，而非只在事后复盘。维护带期望文档 id 的标注问题集；比较重建前后 recall 与 nDCG。少数语言或长尾 SKU 回归即使英文指标平坦也应阻断 alias 切换。在每次 cutover 更新的目录中记录各团队使用的 alias。
切换后 72 小时监控查询延迟、缓存命中率与带 search 标签的工单。只读保留旧索引并设 dated TTL，回滚只需改 alias 而非恐慌重嵌。归档重建清单——源快照 id、批作业 id、审批链接——以应对向量是否使用过期 consent 类的审计提问。

ja.title: Embeddingインデックス再構築戦略
ja.excerpt: embeddingモデルやチャンク方針を変えると旧インデックスが静かに誤回答する。無計画リビルドは検索停止とコスト爆発。
ja.description: 無停止リビルド：ブルーグリーン、シャドウインデックス、メタデータ固定、オフライン品質ゲート。

sections.heading: モデル変更は静かな回帰
paragraphs: 本番検索を稼働させたまま裏で新インデックス構築が標準。
デュアルライトかバッチbackfillでシャドウへ；cutoverはエイリアスswap。

sections.heading: ブルーグリーンで無停止切替
paragraphs: ドキュメントごとにembeddingモデルid、チャンク版、正規化パラメータをmetadataに。
クエリ層が非互換版を拒否；混在ベクトル空間はretrievalを壊す。
points: ブルーグリーンまたはシャドウインデックスで無停止リビルド
インデックスメタデータでembeddingモデル版を固定
シャードサイズとバッチSLAでリビルドコスト測定
オフラインゴールデンセットで検索品質をゲート

sections.heading: メタデータでモデル版固定
paragraphs: シャード、バッチサイズ、GPU/CPU時間でリビルドコスト測定；cutover前に予算。
夜間バッチSLAをローンチカレンダーに合わせる；半端リビルドは延期より悪い。

sections.heading: オフラインゴールデンセットでゲート
paragraphs: cutover前にCIでゴールデンセットのnDCGまたはhit@k。
本番で短いシャドウクエリ比較で最終go。

sections.heading: 検索を止めず rebuild
paragraphs: team は index rebuild なしで embedding model を swap し non-English catalog の recall collapse に驚く。index metadata を contract：model id、chunk version、normalization、snapshot id が query guard と match。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
shadow index は prod traffic 中 backfill を可能に。weekend cutover 前に million vector あたり batch 時間と shard cost 測定。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
backfill 中 chunk feature flag freeze しないと mid-job corpus fork。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: alias swap 前に品質を証明
paragraphs: expected doc id 付き offline golden question set が alias swap gate。EN metric flat でも minority language recall regression で cutover block。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
previous index を dated TTL read-only；rollback は alias change。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
rebuild manifest を consent audit 用に publish。 次回の production review で再確認し、オーナーを割り当て、日付付き remediation チケットを紐付けてください。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: 検索 downtime なしの rebuild 運用
paragraphs: embedding model や chunk policy 変更は dashboard が緑のまま retrieval 品質を静かに poison する。shadow index を並行構築し shard ごと SLA 測定 batch backfill、offline golden set recall gate 通過後に alias swap。model id、chunk version、normalization を metadata に pin し active index contract 不一致 query を reject。

継続 traffic では blue-green cutover が in-place reindex に勝る。shadow へ dual-write か staged ingestion で big-bang 週末回避。rebuild コストを百万 vector あたりドルと engineer 時間で track。backfill 中 chunk 境界を変える feature flag を freeze。

quality gate は postmortem だけでなく CI。期待 doc id 付き labeled question set；recall と nDCG を rebuild 前後比較。minority language や long-tail SKU regression は EN metric flat でも alias swap block。cutover ごと更新 catalog に team と alias 対応。

cutover 後 72h query latency、cache hit、search tag support ticket monitor。previous index を dated TTL read-only；rollback は alias で panic re-embed 禁止。rebuild manifest を archive し consent class audit に備える。
